discovery_sources: GET https://staging.phantix.site/status (200, 200,053 bytes — live service/engine/endpoint inventory)

read-only psql on platform db and phantix_security
discovery_gaps: No OpenAPI document: ENABLE_API_DOCS=false; /openapi.json, /docs, /redoc all 404. Route inventory reconstructed from the live /status payload (974 endpoints).
No OpenTelemetry / Jaeger / Sentry. 'Traces' are SSE event logs + ai_audit_logs + platform_events in Postgres.
Staging container stdout was not captured; runtime log lines come from the local dev run (~/Phantix Backend/.run/logs) and are labelled as such.
169.58.162.46 (ssh alias phantix-vuln-lab) is unreachable on 22 and 443.
Mobile/Appium listener (:4723) not observed even though MOBILE_UI_ENABLED=true.

units.label: Cloudflare edge
units.note: Server: cloudflare; CF-RAY seen from LHR/CDG. DYNAMIC, h3 advertised

units.label: coolify-proxy (Traefik v3.6)
units.note: Router Host(staging.phantix.site) -> api:8000, tls letsencrypt, gzip + redirect-to-https middleware

units.label: coolify 4.3.23
units.note: Deploys and watches the compose project; read-only API reachable with ~/.coolify_token

units.label: coolify-db (postgres:15)
units.note: Coolify's own metadata DB — not the product DB

units.label: api (uvicorn)
units.note: UVICORN_WORKERS=2. Hosts ALL 13 engines in-process plus the middleware chain, the engine bus and the engine registry. Holds /var/run/docker.sock.

units.label: slowapi rate limit
units.note: RATE_LIMIT_ENABLED=true, RATE_LIMIT_DEFAULT=500/min, service key 120/min — Redis-backed, 429 + Retry-After

units.label: RequestTimeout 10s
units.note: API_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=10 — hard ceiling on any request-path work

units.label: app-session + device token
units.note: APP_SESSION_ENFORCE=true, 30 min absolute / 20 min inactivity, silent renewal

units.label: OrgOperate + dual control
units.note: Blocks state-changing operations until an authorizer approves; Redis dual_control:{id}

units.label: audit + 5xx event middleware
units.note: AUDIT_MIDDLEWARE_ASYNC=true; writes platform_events; injects X-Correlation-Id into every response

units.label: control_plane
units.note: 411 endpoints — auth, orgs, billing, staff, support, integrations

units.label: soc_engine
units.note: 121 endpoints — detections, cases, rules, war-room, availability, endpoint monitoring

units.label: asset_engine
units.note: 70 endpoints — inventory, discovery, tags, GitHub/GitLab/Gitea, asset graph

units.label: compliance_engine
units.note: 52 endpoints — NDPR/ISO/SOC2/PCI/GDPR mapping, questionnaires

units.label: reporting_engine
units.note: 45 endpoints — report assembly, CVSS enrichment, finding tracker, funnel

units.label: vapt_engine
units.note: 40 endpoints — campaigns, procedures, approvals, schedules, correlation

units.label: operations_engine
units.note: 34 endpoints — monitoring, /status, developer logs, superadmin terminal

units.label: scanner_engine
units.note: 30 endpoints — scan orchestration, tool adapters, cloud security

units.label: ai_engine
units.note: Chief Security Agent, verification, autofix, AGI service (owns the AGI session cap of 4)

units.label: threat_model_engine
units.note: 18 endpoints — /context, threat models, document + diagram ingestion

units.label: risk_engine
units.note: 14 endpoints — scoring, treatments, residual risk

units.label: audit_engine
units.note: 14 endpoints — immutable audit trail

units.label: alert_engine
units.note: 13 endpoints — severity-routed notifications

units.label: engine bus
units.note: IN-PROCESS subscriber registry (not Redis pub/sub, not LISTEN/NOTIFY). ~90 event contracts. Non-local subscribers fan out through celery as one message per event.

units.label: engine registry
units.note: Manifest-driven: 13/13 registered, 0 missing. Builds the /status engine + endpoint inventory.

units.label: superadmin terminal (local PTY)
units.note: SUPERADMIN_TERMINAL_ENABLED=true, MODE=local, shell /bin/bash — a shell inside the api container, reachable from the admin API

units.label: worker-scans
units.note: celery -Q scans -c 3. Mounts docker.sock (foreground `docker run` for tool containers).

units.label: worker-vapt
units.note: celery -Q vapt -c 2. max_retries=0 on run_campaign by design.

units.label: worker-ai
units.note: celery -Q ai -c 1. Single slot for every LLM task.

units.label: worker-reports
units.note: --max-memory-per-child=500000

units.label: worker-bus
units.note: Also drains the default `celery` queue: staff alerts, funnel, ops, soc, agi.semantica_ingest

units.label: beat (RedBeat)
units.note: Single leader holding securegraph:redbeat:lock (TTL 47s at sample). 26 scheduled entries. No beat-standby in staging.

units.label: alert-daemon
units.note: Non-Celery asyncio loop, --interval 5, batch 50. Heartbeat fresh (age 2.2s at sample). The liveness path that does not go through Celery.

units.label: job_reaper
units.note: Every 300s: reaps stalled ai_agent_runs, repo jobs, reports, vapt campaigns, scan_jobs (-> interrupted + resumable, celery revoke SIGTERM), discovery_jobs

units.label: sandbox-image (one-shot)
units.note: docker:27-cli; builds phantix-agi-sandbox:latest and creates the keeper container. Last run Exited(0) 3 days ago.

units.label: db (postgres:16-alpine)
units.note: Platform DB `phantix`. max_connections 150, shared_buffers 1GB, work_mem 8MB, mem_limit 3g. Pool per process 10 + 10 overflow.

units.label: bench-security-db (postgres:16-alpine)
units.note: DB `phantix_security`, schemas: public + phantix. Reached per-org through the SECURITY DB POOL (1 live pool, org 4, size 1 free 1, min 1 max 5, expire 90s). Credentials live encrypted in platform `customer_db_connections`.

units.label: redis (redis:7-alpine)
units.note: One container, at least 9 distinct jobs: celery broker, celery result backend, redbeat, slowapi rate limit, per-org tool locks + global scan slots, security-db cred cache, leader election, scan result spool, agent authorization. maxmemory 768mb allkeys-lru + AOF. REDIS_FAIL_OPEN=false → tool locks fail closed.

units.label: phantix_storage volume
units.note: OBJECT_STORAGE_BACKEND=local. Mounted /app/data. Buckets used by code: securegraph-apk-uploads, phantix-reports, securegraph-storage, securegraph-screenshots, securegraph-code-graphs. S3 endpoint/keys EMPTY.

units.label: scans
units.note: Concurrency 3; also carries scan.orchestrate/run_work_item fan-out loop

units.label: vapt
units.note: Concurrency 2; poll_schedules every 60s

units.label: ai
units.note: Concurrency 1 — the LLM choke point for the whole platform

units.label: alerts
units.note: process_pending every 30s + staff alerts + billing lifecycle

units.label: bus
units.note: Cross-process engine event fan-out + dead-letter retry (max 5, 60s)

units.label: celery (default)
units.note: Catch-all: ops, soc, staff_alerts, funnel, agi.semantica_ingest have no task_routes glob

units.label: continuous
units.note: continuous.reassess every 3600s, accepted_risk_review / context_drift_sweep / learning_feed daily

units.label: integrations
units.note: health_checks 900s, refresh_tokens 3600s

units.label: phantix-agi-runner
units.note: FastAPI, single uvicorn worker, 0 sessions at sample. ALL session state in process memory — a restart loses every live session. Sessions capped at 4 by the API (PHANTIX_AGI_MAX_CONCURRENT_SESSIONS), not by the runner. Holds docker.sock.

units.label: _agent_loop (orchestrator)
units.note: Turn loop: rebuild prompt (system prompt + last 8 history entries), stream model, dispatch tools, evaluate stop. MAX_TURNS_PER_PHASE=40, MAX_AUTONOMOUS_TURNS=3000, MAX_TOOLS=8000. Can sit in clarification wait for 24h by default.

units.label: oversight / mission control
units.note: VERDICTS allow|gate|require_confirmation|steer|deny + DriftMonitor (window 10, threshold 4). Wired at _oversight_gate, but NOTHING sets oversight_enforced=True anywhere in the repo → in this deployment it observes and does not block.

units.label: finding_manager
units.note: Concurrency 8, batch 32, poll 6s, max 500. Concurrently verifies and promotes findings for the life of the session.

units.label: candidate_verifier
units.note: Skeptical triager, 3 turns / 45s deadline. Verify-all fan-out concurrency 12, budget 900s. Die -> inconclusive, never dropped.

units.label: exploit_subagent
units.note: Adversarial exploit auditor, 4 turns / 60s

units.label: recon_subagent
units.note: Read-only recon, 5 turns / 90s. Tools http_get, dns_lookup, nmap_top.

units.label: autofix_subagent
units.note: Advisory remediation, sequential per finding, 45s deadline, loops up to 20 findings

units.label: pi_subagent
units.note: Spawns the `pi` CLI headless as a subprocess. Provider zai, model glm-5.3-flash, tools read,grep,find,ls,bash, timeout 120s, max 2 concurrent.

units.label: specialist sweepers (15)
units.note: One pool, sequential, max_assignments=1, 180s budget each. Triggered ONLY by the JOB_DONE coverage gate and only when autonomy=high (model_led_prompt). The idle path does NOT call them.

units.label: knowledge_keeper
units.note: The only thing resembling retrieval: injects prior session summaries + a static 12-category gap playbook into the prompt. Writes agi_knowledge_summaries via the API. NOTE: there is no vector store, no embedding call and no reranker in this service.

units.label: /data/agi-artifacts
units.note: Filesystem volume, token_urlsafe(24) dirs, 168h retention, purge at boot + every 6h + on teardown. Not S3.

units.label: scope_guard + prompt_guard
units.note: scope_guard FAILS CLOSED (empty allowlist -> block). prompt_guard enforces forbidden.md. Second scope check inside oversight is inactive (called without scope_ok).

units.label: tool catalogue (47 sandbox + 34 advanced + 16 probes)
units.note: Plain in-process Python functions. 47 named sandbox binaries, 34 advanced tool names, 16 probe classes. NOT an MCP server, NOT a tool microservice, no JSON-RPC.

units.label: sandbox pool
units.note: asyncio.Semaphore(max). Acquire timeout 900s -> 503 on provision. Pooled and scrubbed between leases, NOT container-per-call. Each container: --memory 1g --cpus 1, 512 pids, cap_drop ALL + NET_RAW, ro scope mount, label phantix.agi.pool=1.

units.label: phantix-agi-0f78afd24ab0
units.note: Live, up 10 hours, leased/idle

units.label: phantix-agi-3e9be8219a34
units.note: Live, up 10 hours, leased/idle

units.label: phantix-agi-sandbox-keeper
units.note: Created (stopped) on purpose: pins the image against `docker image prune -a`

units.label: NO MCP SERVER DEPLOYED
units.note: Verified: no mcp service in any compose file, no systemd unit, no .mcp.json, ~/.claude.json mcpServers == {}. grep -l mcp over services/phantix-agi returns 0 files. The agent tool layer is in-process Python + docker exec.

units.label: BurpMCPAdapter
units.note: BURP_MCP_ENDPOINT and BURP_API_URL are both EMPTY on staging -> the adapter returns stubbed results. Burp Suite Pro IS running on the host, but nothing on the request path reaches it (PROXY_FAILOVER_ENABLED=false).

units.label: CaidoMCPAdapter
units.note: CAIDO_MCP_ENABLED=false and CAIDO_SUSPENDED=true. CAIDO_GRAPHQL_URL is EMPTY on the api container. stdio launch configured (caido-mcp-server) but never invoked.

units.label: customer MCP introspection
units.note: mcp_surface.py POSTs JSON-RPC tools/list to a CUSTOMER-supplied endpoint, SSRF-guarded, <=50 tools, reads name+description only. This is the only live MCP code path, and it points outbound at tenants, not inward.

units.label: opencode serve
units.note: Host systemd unit phantix-opencode.service, WorkingDirectory /opt/phantix-opencode/workspace, OPENCODE_CONFIG config/opencode.json. The 'contractor' that the AGI skill_handoff routes work to.

units.label: phantix-opencode-proxy (socat)
units.note: alpine/socat: TCP-LISTEN:4096,fork,reuseaddr -> host.docker.internal:4096. On the Coolify network, so containers reach it as http://phantix-opencode-proxy:4096. Up 7 weeks.

units.label: Burp Suite Professional
units.note: Host systemd, Xvfb DISPLAY=:99, JAVA_HOME /opt/BurpSuitePro/jre. Headless but GUI-shaped. Not addressed by any live config.

units.label: x11vnc :5901 + noVNC :6080
units.note: Interactive view of the Burp desktop

units.label: adb server :5037
units.note: MOBILE_UI_ENABLED=true, MOBILE_APPIUM_URL=http://127.0.0.1:4723 — but no process is listening on 4723. UNVERIFIED whether the mobile path functions.

units.label: whtbin :18082
units.note: UNIDENTIFIED. Listening on 127.0.0.1 only. Not referenced by any config we found.

units.label: amazing_cohen
units.note: UNMANAGED, up 9 days. Runs a shell loop probing katana / dalfox / kr / dirsearch / nuclei availability and hitting example.com. Not in any compose file.

units.label: trusting_solomon, relaxed_banzai, phantix-api-src-sandbox-image-1
units.note: Exited containers left on the host (6d, 7d, 3d). No labels tying them to a live stack.

units.label: DeepSeek api.deepseek.com
units.note: Key SET. Probed from the api container: HTTP 401 (reachable). Primary for the platform ai_engine AND the AGI runner's stream.

units.label: Z.AI api.z.ai/paas/v4
units.note: Key SET. HTTP 301 (reachable). Two roles: AGI GLM fallback on 401/402/408/429/5xx, and the provider for pi_subagent.

units.label: AgentRouter agentrouter.org
units.note: Key SET, HTTP 200. AI_ALLOW_AGENTROUTER_IN_PROD=false but ENVIRONMENT=staging. Real historical calls succeeded: 'AI audit agent=executive_summary model=agentrouter/claude-opus-4-8'.

units.label: Moonshot api.moonshot.cn
units.note: KIMI_API_KEY SET, HTTP 200. No live call sites observed in logs.

units.label: NVIDIA NIM integrate.api.nvidia.com
units.note: NVIDIA_API_KEY SET (70 chars), NVIDIA_BASE_URL SET. No live call sites observed.

units.label: TypeSafe System One api.typesafe.ai
units.note: TYPESAFE_API_KEY SET (107 chars) on BOTH api and AGI runner. POST /v1/systemone. Used as a fast typed gate for routing and finding verdicts (real finding / expected access control / inconclusive). Max 80 gates per session.

units.label: unconfigured providers
units.note: All keys EMPTY or vars absent. The provider catalogue implements them; staging does not. Shown so multiplicity is not hidden.

units.label: Brevo SMTP relay
units.note: smtp-relay.brevo.com:587, from=noreply@phantix.site. Live: /status confirms configured. Alert engine email channel + staff alerts.

units.label: GitHub App (phantix-security-solutions)
units.note: GITHUB_APP_ID + private key SET, slug phantix-security-solutions. Asset engine + branch review + autofix PRs.

units.label: Paystack api.paystack.co
units.note: Key SET. Billing + HMAC webhook ingress.

units.label: NVD CVE API
units.note: NVD_API_KEY SET. reporting_engine cvss_enricher. Beat: refresh-cve-cache-weekly.

units.label: VirusTotal
units.note: Key SET (64 chars). yaml_scan_executor IP reputation.

units.label: DuckDuckGo HTML
units.note: PHANTIX_AGI_WEB_SEARCH_PROVIDER=duckduckgo. The AGI research path. TAVILY_API_KEY is EMPTY.

units.label: Telegram / WhatsApp / Tavily / Mailinator / OTX / urlscan / Mnemonic
units.note: Channels exist in code and are advertised in the alert policy (critical -> email + WhatsApp + Telegram), but every token is EMPTY on staging. Critical alerts therefore degrade to email only. Flagged rather than dropped.

units.label: Elasticsearch
units.note: ELASTICSEARCH_ENABLED=false, no container running. /status reports it as ok+disabled.

units.label: Slack / Teams / Jira / Linear / PagerDuty / SARIF
units.note: INTEGRATIONS_HUB_ENABLED=true. OAuth/webhook targets are per-org, so activity depends on tenant configuration, not on staging env.

units.label: phantixvulnserver.online (169.58.110.182)

units.note: Live org rows: 1 NexaPay, 3 QA Test Company, 4 Phantix Vulnerable Organization, 11 Phantix Funnel, 12 Bifoluwa. Org 4 is the one with an active security DB pool.
